## F — Ready to Drive
Research index: Ready to Drive; the main and continuation fact chunks contain 64 and 55 manually authored, page-anchored statements.
Physical-page coverage: 23 through 38, in handbook order.
VERIFY: ME-SEC03-COUNT — question count; ME-SEC03-PASS — passing standard; ME-SEC03-TIME — time limit.
VERIFY: ME-SEC03-MARKET — market pack; ME-SEC03-TEARDOWN — competitor teardown.
VERIFY: ME-READY-PASSENGER-PENALTY — Resolve additional passenger-under-twenty-one suspension: physical page twenty-eight states one hundred eighty days and physical page thirty-three states two hundred seventy-five days. Both numeric enhancement claims are withheld.
VERIFY: ME-READY-STATISTICS — Source/date and verify survey prevalence, distraction/crash multipliers, alcohol-related fatality and social-statistic estimates before current learner use.
VERIFY: ME-READY-ILLUSTRATIVE-COST — Verify the illustrative OUI cost breakdown and distinguish it from actual statutory penalties before displaying any estimate.
VERIFY: ME-READY-PHYSIOLOGY — Verify universal low-BAC vision effects, glare-recovery timing and nighttime vision percentage before learner assertion.
VERIFY: ME-READY-IMPLIED-CONSENT — Verify current legal predicates for a demanded alcohol test rather than teaching the handbook’s unrestricted-at-any-time wording.
VERIFY: ME-READY-BRAC-WORDING — Resolve percentage-versus-mass-per-breath-volume wording in the BrAC definition before using its percentage terminology.
VERIFY: ME-READY-DRUG-CLASSIFICATION — Correct the cocaine/narcotic grouping and verify severe generalized drug-interaction mechanisms using a current authoritative source.
Fact-check receipts in the worker scratch preserve all drafted fact ids and source-fidelity verdicts. Those same-model receipts do not substitute for independent QA.
